verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a media-over-QUIC relay and CDN server. A streaming infrastructure product could plausibly offer AI-driven analytics or insights, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence describes any built-in AI insight or suggestion feature. SageOx's transcription and voice-ID consumers are the user's own external subscribers, a user-side workaround that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
